national.title: UNICEF: 1.100 Anak Ukraina Tewas dan Terluka Akibat Perang Tahun Ini
national.summary: UNICEF melaporkan 1.144 anak tewas atau terluka akibat perang Ukraina-Rusia pada 2026. Angka ini meningkat signifikan dibanding tahun lalu.

international.title: Home Alone sequel reportedly in development with Macaulay Culkin returning
international.summary: Christmas comedy hit is set for a follow-up from the point of view of the father with Seth Rogen as writer and producer A Home Alone sequel is reportedly in development with original star Macaulay Culkin set to return. According to Puck’s Matthew Belloni , Culkin met with Disney executives earlier this year with a pitch for a follow-up and now the project has been met with a green light. The new Home Alone film will bring the 46-year-old back to the franchise as Kevin McCallister for a comedy that, according to Deadline , will be from the father’s point of view. Continue reading...

international.title: Belgrade mayor charged with assaulting opposition politician in Serbia
international.summary: Prosecutors say Aleksandar Sapic caused serious facial injuries to a female councillor and seek a three-year sentence.
